questions.question_hindi: यदि आधार से लिंक न होने के कारण किसी कर्मचारी का स्थायी खाता संख्या (PAN) 'निष्क्रिय' (inoperative) हो जाता है, तो नियोक्ता (DDO) द्वारा उसके वेतन पर टीडीएस (TDS) कटौती के संबंध में तत्काल विधिक परिणाम क्या होता है?

questions.question_english: If an employee's Permanent Account Number (PAN) becomes 'inoperative' due to non-linking with Aadhaar, what is the immediate legal consequence regarding TDS deduction on their salary by the employer (DDO)?
options_english: TDS will not be deducted at all until the PAN is linked
The employee is deemed to have failed to furnish a PAN, attracting a higher TDS rate of 20% under Section 206AA
TDS is deducted at normal rates, but the employee is barred from claiming an income tax refund
The employee faces immediate deemed suspension from service under Conduct Rules
questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 114AAA(3) of the Income Tax Rules, 1962 and CBDT Circular No. 03/2023 dated March 28, 2023, where a person's PAN has become inoperative due to failure to link it with Aadhaar:
1. The PAN holder is treated as if they have not furnished or quoted the PAN for all provisions of the Act.
2. Consequently, under Section 206AA, tax must be deducted at source at a higher rate (i.e. at 20% or the applicable rate, whichever is higher).
3. Furthermore, no tax refunds will be issued for inoperative PANs, and no interest is payable on refunds under Section 244A for the inoperative period.
Therefore, the DDO is legally obligated to deduct TDS at the higher rate of 20% under Section 206AA.
questions.explanation_hindi:
आयकर नियम, 1962 के नियम 114AAA(3) और सीबीडीटी (CBDT) परिपत्र संख्या 03/2023 (दिनांक 28 मार्च 2023) के अनुसार, यदि आधार से लिंक न होने के कारण किसी व्यक्ति का पैन 'निष्क्रिय' हो जाता है:
1. उस व्यक्ति को आयकर अधिनियम के समस्त प्रावधानों के लिए पैन प्रस्तुत न करने वाला (Non-furnishing of PAN) माना जाता है।
2. परिणामस्वरूप, धारा 206AA के तहत DDO/नियोक्ता द्वारा उसके वेतन पर 20% (या लागू दर, जो भी अधिक हो) की उच्च दंडात्मक दर से टीडीएस काटना अनिवार्य हो जाता है।
3. इसके अतिरिक्त, निष्क्रिय पैन होने पर आयकर रिफंड जारी नहीं किया जाता और निष्क्रिय अवधि के लिए रिफंड पर ब्याज भी देय नहीं होता है।
अतः कर्मचारी को पैन न रखने वाला मानकर 20% की उच्च दर से टीडीएस काटा जाएगा।

questions.question_english: What is the structural alphanumeric composition of a valid Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number (TAN)?
questions.explanation_english: A valid Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number (TAN) is a unique 10-digit alphanumeric identifier structured strictly as: 4 Alphabets, followed by 5 Numerals, and ending with 1 Alphabet (e.g., DELA12345B). Specifically: (i) the first 3 alphabets represent the jurisdiction/city code of the issuing authority (e.g., DEL for Delhi); (ii) the 4th alphabet denotes the initial letter of the deductor's name or office; (iii) the subsequent 5 numeric characters are unique sequential numbers; and (iv) the final character is a check digit. In contrast, a PAN is structured as 5 Alphabets, 4 Numerals, 1 Alphabet.

DELA12345B)। इसमें प्रथम तीन अक्षर क्षेत्राधिकार/शहर कोड दर्शाते हैं, चौथा अक्षर कटौतीकर्ता के नाम का पहला अक्षर होता है, अगले पांच संख्यात्मक अंक अद्वितीय क्रम संख्या होते हैं तथा अंतिम अक्षर एक चेक कैरेक्टर होता है। इसके विपरीत, पैन (PAN) की संरचना 5 अक्षर + 4 अंक + 1 अक्षर होती है।

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the fundamentals of taxation for a salaried individual:
I. Total Income is calculated after allowing deductions under Chapter VI-A from the Gross Total Income.
II. Salary income is taxed on a due basis or receipt basis, whichever is earlier.
III. An individual is liable to pay Advance Tax if their estimated tax liability for the financial year is ₹10,000 or more.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english:
All three statements are correct under the Income Tax Act, 1961:
1. Statement I is correct: Total Income (taxable income) under Section 2(45) and Section 80A is derived by deducting allowable deductions under Chapter VI-A (Sections 80C, 80D, etc.) from the Gross Total Income (aggregate of all heads).
2. Statement II is correct: Under Section 15, income under the head 'Salaries' is chargeable to tax on a due basis (accrual) or receipt basis, whichever occurs earlier.
3. Statement III is correct: Under Section 208, advance tax is mandatory for any assessee whose estimated tax liability for the financial year (after accounting for TDS/TCS) is ₹10,000 or more.
questions.explanation_hindi:
आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 के अनुसार तीनों कथन सही हैं:
1. कथन I सही है: सकल कुल आय (GTI) में से अध्याय VI-A (धारा 80C से 80U) के तहत अनुमत कटौतियां घटाने के बाद ही कुल कर-योग्य आय (Total Income) प्राप्त होती है।
2. कथन II सही है: धारा 15 के अनुसार, वेतन आय देय होने की तिथि अथवा प्राप्त होने की तिथि, जो भी पहले घटित हो, पर कर-योग्य होती है।
3. कथन III सही है: धारा 208 के अंतर्गत, यदि किसी निर्धारिती की संबंधित वित्तीय वर्ष में टीडीएस कटौती के पश्चात शुद्ध कर देनदारी ₹10,000 या उससे अधिक बनती है, तो उसे अग्रिम कर (एडवांस टैक्स) देना अनिवार्य होता है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) I, II, and III

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Total income is determined after subtracting Chapter VI-A deductions from gross total income. Income under salaries is taxable on due or receipt basis, whichever occurs earlier. Furthermore, advance tax provisions mandate that any individual whose estimated tax liability equals or exceeds ten thousand rupees in a financial year must pay tax in advance.

questions.question_english: Which of the following statements INCORRECTLY compares the standard deduction available under 'Salaries' with the statutory deduction available under 'Family Pension'?
questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन 'वेतन' (Salaries) के तहत मिलने वाली मानक कटौती और 'पारिवारिक पेंशन' (Family Pension) के तहत मिलने वाली वैधानिक कटौती की गलत तुलना करता है?
options_english: Standard deduction under the head 'Salaries' is a flat amount of up to ₹50,000.
Family Pension received by legal heirs is assessed under the head 'Income from Other Sources'.
The statutory deduction for Family Pension under Section 57(iia) is 33.33% of the pension or ₹15,000, whichever is less (under the old tax regime).
The standard deduction for Family Pension is ₹50,000, exactly identical to the deduction under regular salary.
options_hindi: 'वेतन' शीर्षक के तहत मानक कटौती ₹50,000 तक की एकमुश्त राशि है।
कानूनी वारिसों द्वारा प्राप्त पारिवारिक पेंशन का निर्धारण 'अन्य स्रोतों से आय' शीर्षक के तहत किया जाता है।
धारा 57(iia) के तहत पारिवारिक पेंशन के लिए वैधानिक कटौती पेंशन का 33.33% या ₹15,000 (जो भी कम हो) है (पुरानी व्यवस्था में)।
पारिवारिक पेंशन के लिए मानक कटौती ₹50,000 है, जो नियमित वेतन कटौती के बिल्कुल समान है।
questions.explanation_english:
Statement D is incorrect and hence the correct answer.
- Regular pension is received by the employee themselves from their former employer and is taxed under the head 'Salaries' (Section 17(1)). Salaried pensioners receive a flat standard deduction under Section 16(ia) of up to ₹50,000.
- In contrast, 'Family Pension' is received by the spouse or legal dependents after the death of the employee/pensioner. Since there is no employer-employee relationship between the recipient and the government/employer, family pension is taxable under the head 'Income from Other Sources' (Section 56).
- The deduction for family pension is governed by Section 57(iia), which restricts the deduction to 33.33% (one-third) of the family pension or ₹15,000, whichever is less (under the traditional provisions; enhanced to ₹25,000 under the New Regime by Finance Act 2024). It is definitely NOT ₹50,000 identical to regular salary.
questions.explanation_hindi:
कथन D गलत है और इसलिए यही सही उत्तर है।
- नियमित पेंशन सेवानिवृत्त कर्मचारी को स्वयं प्राप्त होती है और इसे आयकर अधिनियम की धारा 17(1) के तहत 'वेतन' (Salaries) माना जाता है, जिस पर धारा 16(ia) के तहत ₹50,000 तक की मानक कटौती मिलती है।
- इसके विपरीत, 'पारिवारिक पेंशन' कर्मचारी/पेंशनभोगी की मृत्यु के बाद उसके आश्रित परिजनों (पति/पत्नी आदि) को मिलती है। आश्रितों और नियोक्ता के बीच कोई सेवा-संबंध न होने के कारण पारिवारिक पेंशन पर 'अन्य स्रोतों से आय' (धारा 56) के तहत कर लगता है।
- धारा 57(iia) के अंतर्गत पारिवारिक पेंशन पर कटौती की सीमा पेंशन राशि का 33.33% (1/3 भाग) या ₹15,000 (जो भी कम हो) निर्धारित है। पारिवारिक पेंशन पर ₹50,000 की सामान्य वेतन मानक कटौती लागू नहीं होती।

questions.question_english: A Vice-Principal receives arrears of salary amounting to ₹2,50,000 for a past period due to the implementation of a Pay Commission report. What is the most appropriate course of action for the DDO regarding the tax deduction on these arrears?
options_english: The DDO computes tax in the year of receipt and grants tax relief under Section 89(1) upon submission of Form 10E.
The DDO must fully exempt the entire arrears amount from tax computation since it strictly pertains to earlier financial years.
The DDO must divide the arrears equally over the remaining years of service and deduct tax proportionately.
The DDO should instruct the employee to pay the tax directly to the Income Tax Department without making any TDS.
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 15(c) of the Income Tax Act, 1961, arrears of salary not taxed in earlier years are chargeable to tax in the financial year in which they are received. However, because receiving past arrears in a single lump sum may push the employee into a higher tax bracket, Section 89(1) read with Rule 21A provides tax relief. Under Section 192(2A), a government Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) is legally empowered to compute and grant this relief under Section 89(1) directly while deducting TDS at source, provided the employee files Form 10E electronically on the income tax portal and furnishes the verification/particulars to the DDO.
questions.explanation_hindi: आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 15(c) के अनुसार, यदि वेतन बकाए पर पूर्व में कर नहीं लगा है, तो वह प्राप्ति के वित्तीय वर्ष में कर-योग्य होता है। एकमुश्त बकाया मिलने से कर्मचारी उच्च कर स्लैब में आ सकता है, जिसके समाधान हेतु धारा 89(1) व नियम 21A के तहत कर राहत (टैक्स रिलीफ) का प्रावधान है। धारा 192(2A) के तहत सरकारी DDO को यह अधिकार है कि वह कर्मचारी द्वारा आयकर पोर्टल पर फॉर्म 10E (Form 10E) ऑनलाइन दाखिल करने और विवरण प्रस्तुत करने पर टीडीएस की गणना करते समय सीधे धारा 89(1) की कर राहत प्रदान कर सकता है।

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: receipt and allows relief under Section 89(1) via Form 10E. When arrears of salary are received, tax must be computed in the financial year of receipt. questions.question_english: A government school located in Delhi places an order and procures laboratory equipment from an authorized vendor whose registered place of business is in Haryana. Which type of Goods and Services Tax (GST) must be charged by the supplier on the tax invoice?

questions.explanation_english:
Under Section 7(1) of the Integrated Goods and Services Tax (IGST) Act, 2017:
1. Where the location of the supplier (Haryana) and the place of supply (Delhi, where goods are delivered to the recipient school) are in two different States/Union Territories, the transaction constitutes an 'Inter-State supply'.
2. Under Section 5(1) of the IGST Act, 2017, Integrated Goods and Services Tax (IGST) is levied on all inter-state supplies of goods or services.
3. Note on exemptions: While certain educational services provided by or to educational institutions are exempt under Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate), procurement of taxable goods (such as science apparatus/laboratory equipment) does NOT enjoy any blanket exemption. The supplier must charge IGST on the tax invoice.
Therefore, the correct tax is IGST.

questions.explanation_english: Under Section 192, Section 200, and Section 204 of the Income Tax Act, 1961, the Drawing and Disbursing Officer (Principal) is designated as the person responsible for paying salary and withholding tax, functioning as a statutory fiduciary agent of the Central Government. The DDO's duty is neither to act as a tax avoidance advisor for employees nor as an overzealous tax collector ignoring lawful exemptions. The guiding principle is absolute statutory compliance: providing an opportunity to employees to declare their tax regime and submit proof of valid investments, objectively evaluating deduction claims within the framework of the law, deducting the exact monthly TDS at average rates, remitting collections to the treasury by the statutory due dates, filing quarterly statements (Form 24Q), and issuing Form 16 certificates.
questions.explanation_hindi: आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 192, 200 और 204 के तहत, आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी (DDO/प्राचार्य) वेतन भुगतान और कर कटौती के लिए उत्तरदायी व्यक्ति होता है, जो केंद्र सरकार के एक सांविधिक प्रतिनिधि (Statutory Agent) के रूप में कार्य करता है। DDO का कर्तव्य न तो कर चोरी या कृत्रिम रूप से कर घटाने में कर्मचारियों की मदद करना है और न ही वैध छूटों को नजरअंदाज करके अत्यधिक कर वसूलना है। इसका मार्गदर्शक सिद्धांत पूर्णतः विधि सम्मत और निष्पक्ष कार्यप्रणाली है: कर्मचारियों से उनकी चुनी गई कर व्यवस्था और वैध निवेशों के प्रमाण प्राप्त करना, कानूनी दायरे में कटौतियों का निष्पक्ष सत्यापन करना, औसत दर से प्रतिमाह सटीक टीडीएस काटना, काटी गई राशि को समय पर सरकारी राजकोष में जमा करना, त्रैमासिक विवरण (फॉर्म 24Q) दाखिल करना तथा कर्मचारियों को फॉर्म 16 जारी करना। अतः विकल्प D सही उत्तर है।

questions.question_english: Under the dual GST model adopted by India, which combination of taxes is concurrently levied on an 'Intra-State' supply of taxable goods or services?
options_english: Central GST (CGST) and State GST (SGST) [or UTGST]
questions.explanation_english:
India adopted a dual GST architecture given its federal constitutional structure, where both the Central and State Governments concurrently levy indirect tax on a common taxable base:
1. Intra-State Supply: When the location of the supplier and the place of supply are in the same State or Union Territory, the supply is termed intra-state. On such transactions, Central GST (CGST) is levied by the Central Government and State GST (SGST) is levied by the State Government [or Union Territory GST (UTGST) in Union Territories without a legislature], both at equal rates.
2. Inter-State Supply: When the supplier and place of supply are in different States/UTs, Integrated GST (IGST) is levied by the Centre under the IGST Act, 2017.
Therefore, on intra-state supplies, CGST and SGST/UTGST are levied simultaneously.

भारत ने अपने संघीय ढांचे के अनुरूप दोहरा जीएसटी (Dual GST) मॉडल अपनाया है, जिसमें केंद्र और राज्य दोनों एक ही कर योग्य आधार पर समवर्ती रूप से कर लगाते हैं:
1. अंतः-राज्य आपूर्ति (Intra-State Supply): जब आपूर्तिकर्ता का स्थान और आपूर्ति का स्थान एक ही राज्य या केंद्र शासित प्रदेश के भीतर हो, तो इसे अंतः-राज्य आपूर्ति कहते हैं। ऐसी आपूर्ति पर केंद्र सरकार द्वारा 'केंद्रीय जीएसटी' (CGST) और संबंधित राज्य सरकार द्वारा 'राज्य जीएसटी' (SGST) [विधानसभा रहित केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों में UTGST] दोनों समान अनुपात में लगाए जाते हैं।
2. अंतर-राज्यीय आपूर्ति (Inter-State Supply): जब आपूर्तिकर्ता और आपूर्ति का स्थान अलग-अलग राज्यों में हों, तो केवल एकीकृत जीएसटी (IGST) लगाया जाता है।
अतः अंतः-राज्य आपूर्ति पर CGST और SGST (या UTGST) का संयोजन लगाया जाता है।

questions.question_english: Which prescribed statutory return must be filed monthly by a government department or educational institution that is required to deduct TDS under Section 51 of the Central Goods and Services Tax (CGST) Act?
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 51 of the CGST Act, 2017 read with Rule 66 of the CGST Rules, 2017, every entity required to deduct tax at source (TDS deductors, including government departments and local authorities) must file a monthly return in Form GSTR-7 electronically on the common GST portal. Form GSTR-7 must be furnished on or before the 10th day of the month succeeding the calendar month in which the deduction was made. It reports details of TDS deducted, tax deposited, and supplier GSTINs, which auto-populates in the suppliers' electronic cash ledger. In contrast, GSTR-1 is for outward supplies, GSTR-3B is the monthly summary return, and GSTR-9 is the annual return.

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): The statutory responsibility of a Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) ends as soon as the TDS amount is deposited into the government account/bank.
Reason (R): Filing of quarterly TDS returns (Form 24Q/26Q) and generating TRACES certificates is a statutory requirement to ensure the deductee receives proper tax credit in their Form 26AS/AIS.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation_english:
Assertion (A) is false: The statutory responsibilities of a DDO do not terminate upon remitting the tax into the government account under Section 200(1). Under Section 200(3), the DDO is legally mandated to prepare and file quarterly TDS returns (Form 24Q for salaries, Form 26Q for non-salary payments) within the prescribed due dates. Furthermore, under Section 203, the DDO must generate and deliver the TDS certificate (Form 16/16A) downloaded from the TRACES portal to the deductee.
Reason (R) is true: Mere payment of tax does not allocate tax credits to individual deductees. Only when quarterly statements are uploaded with valid PANs and processed by the Income Tax Department's TRACES system do the credits populate the deductee's Form 26AS and Annual Information Statement (AIS). Failure to file returns attracts late filing fees under Section 234E and penalties under Section 271H.
Hence, Assertion (A) is false but Reason (R) is true.
questions.explanation_hindi:
अभिकथन (A) गलत है: केवल टीडीएस की कटौती कर सरकारी खजाने में जमा कर देने से DDO की सांविधिक जिम्मेदारियां समाप्त नहीं होतीं। धारा 200(3) के तहत DDO को निर्धारित समय-सीमा के भीतर त्रैमासिक रिटर्न (फॉर्म 24Q/26Q) दाखिल करना होता है तथा धारा 203 के तहत TRACES पोर्टल से फॉर्म 16/16A डाउनलोड कर कर्मचारी/कटौतीकर्ता को उपलब्ध कराना अनिवार्य होता है।
कारण (R) सही है: जब तक DDO द्वारा कर्मचारियों के सही पैन (PAN) विवरण के साथ त्रैमासिक टीडीएस रिटर्न दाखिल नहीं किया जाता, तब तक जमा किया गया कर कर्मचारी के फॉर्म 26AS/AIS में क्रेडिट के रूप में परिलक्षित नहीं होगा और कर्मचारी अपना आईटीआर दाखिल करते समय कर क्रेडिट का दावा नहीं कर सकेगा।
अतः (A) गलत है परंतु (R) सही है।

key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) A is false but R is true

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Depositing deducted tax into the bank does not conclude a Drawing and Disbursing Officer's compliance obligations. questions.explanation_english: Under Section 15 and Section 17(1) of the Income Tax Act, 1961, salary paid to a female employee during her approved maternity leave period constitutes regular employment remuneration (leave salary) disbursed by the employer. The Income Tax Act does not provide any statutory exemption for maternity leave pay under Section 10 or any other provision. Consequently, maternity leave salary is fully chargeable to tax under the head 'Salaries' as normal salary income, and the DDO is legally required to deduct TDS under Section 192 on such payments.
questions.explanation_hindi: आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 15 और धारा 17(1) के अनुसार, स्वीकृत मातृत्व अवकाश के दौरान महिला कर्मचारी को दिया जाने वाला वेतन नियोक्ता द्वारा देय नियमित सेवा पारिश्रमिक (अवकाश वेतन) का हिस्सा होता है। आयकर अधिनियम की धारा 10 या किसी अन्य प्रावधान के अंतर्गत मातृत्व अवकाश वेतन के लिए कोई कर छूट प्रदान नहीं की गई है। परिणामस्वरूप, यह सामान्य वेतन आय के रूप में पूर्णतः कर-योग्य है और DDO धारा 192 के तहत TDS कटौती की गणना करते समय इसे कुल वेतन में शामिल करने के लिए बाध्य है। अतः विकल्प A सही उत्तर है।

questions.question_english: An employer deducting Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) on the salary of employees under Section 192 is required to submit a quarterly TDS return. Which statutory form is prescribed for filing this quarterly return on salaries?
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 200(3) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 read with Rule 31A of the Income Tax Rules, every Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) or employer deducting tax on salary under Section 192 must file a quarterly return in Form 24Q. Form 24Q contains Annexure I in all four quarters (providing deductee-wise quarterly TDS and challan details) and Annexure II exclusively in the fourth quarter (providing the complete annual salary breakdown, deductions claimed under Chapter VI-A, and final tax computation for each employee). By contrast, Form 26Q is for non-salary domestic payments, Form 27Q is for payments to non-residents, and Form 27EQ is for TCS.

questions.question_english: A regular teacher resigns from service under the Directorate of Education in November. By when is the DDO legally required to issue Form 16 to this resigned employee?
options_english: On or before 15th June of the following financial year
Immediately on the official day of resignation and discharge
Within exactly thirty days from the effective date of resignation
The DDO is exempt from issuing Form 16 to employees who resign mid-year
questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 31 of the Income Tax Rules, 1962, the statutory due date for an employer/DDO to issue Form 16 is 15th June of the financial year immediately following the financial year in which tax was deducted.

Key considerations:
1. Even if an employee resigns, retires, or is discharged midway through the financial year (e.g., in November), the employer can only generate Part A and Part B of Form 16 from TRACES after filing the quarterly TDS statements (Form 24Q), including the annual final quarter return due on 31st May.
2. Therefore, the legally enforceable statutory deadline for issuing Form 16 remains 15th June of the subsequent financial year.
3. While the DDO may issue an provisional income and tax deduction statement to assist the employee with their subsequent employer (for Form 12B purposes), the official TRACES-generated Form 16 has the statutory deadline of 15th June.
questions.explanation_hindi:
आयकर नियम, 1962 के नियम 31 के तहत, नियोक्ता/DDO द्वारा फॉर्म 16 जारी करने की वैधानिक अंतिम तिथि उस वित्तीय वर्ष के ठीक बाद आने वाले वित्तीय वर्ष की 15 जून होती है जिसमें कर की कटौती की गई थी।

प्रमुख बिंदु:
1. भले ही कोई कर्मचारी वित्तीय वर्ष के मध्य में (जैसे नवंबर में) त्यागपत्र दे दे या सेवानिवृत्त हो जाए, नियोक्ता ट्रेसेस (TRACES) पोर्टल से फॉर्म 16 केवल तभी जनरेट कर सकता है जब वह 31 मई तक चौथी तिमाही का टीडीएस रिटर्न (फॉर्म 24Q) दाखिल कर दे।
2. इसलिए, फॉर्म 16 जारी करने की कानूनी रूप से बाध्यकारी वैधानिक समय सीमा अगले वित्तीय वर्ष की 15 जून ही रहती है।
3. हालांकि DDO कर्मचारी को उसके नए नियोक्ता के पास फॉर्म 12B भरने के लिए एक अंतरिम आय और कर कटौती विवरण दे सकता है, लेकिन आधिकारिक फॉर्म 16 के लिए वैधानिक समय सीमा 15 जून ही लागू होती है।
